subject: Mystic-Woburn Transmission Project Update
overview: The Council received a major briefing on a 115 kV underground transmission line passing through the city and discussed leveraging the Chevalier Auditorium for economic revitalization in Medford Square.

items.title: 311 System Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a status update on the implementation of a 311 or 'C-Click-Fix' citizen reporting system.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognition
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Richard and Catherine Grant on their 50th wedding anniversary.

items.title: Chevalier Auditorium Master Plan
items.summary: Discussed the economic potential of the Chevalier Auditorium and requested a master plan, seed money for entertainment, and a report on facility needs including air conditioning. The council also requested that the recent mayoral debate held at the venue be broadcast on local government and educational cable channels.

items.title: Mystic-Woburn Transmission Line Project
items.summary: Received a project update from Eversource Energy regarding a proposed eight-mile underground power line and requested follow-up coordination on traffic signal timing, environmental protections for the Mystic River, and local mitigation efforts.

items.title: Parking Revenue and Police Training
items.summary: Referred a petition regarding the allocation of parking program revenue toward police mental health and stress management training to the Mayor for a financial report and analysis.

items.title: Garden, Narcan, and Reverse 911 Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions to discuss the Council appointee for the Community Garden Commission, request the police department Narcan policy, and refine Reverse 911 protocols to distinguish between emergency and community notifications.

items.title: Dog Park Site Selection
items.summary: Councilor Marks announced that the School Committee approved the Riverbend Park site for a future dog park to be funded via a private grant.

items.title: Brooks Estate and Minutes Approval
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the October 13 meeting and received a status report on water and sewer infrastructure at the Brooks Estate.
